title: NFL Prop Analytics Step 2 — Rolling Sunday Schedule Transport
scope: Make Step 2 schedule truth resilient across future NFL Sundays by generating a GitHub-certified rolling schedule snapshot and using it only when public Streamlit live transport cannot produce a complete independently verified slate.

root_cause.public_streamlit_live_transport: Returned zero usable schedule games while GitHub Actions verified the same slate.
root_cause.stale_fixed_date_acceptance: Step 2 verifier was hardcoded to Sept. 27 and 14 games, which would fail future Sundays with a different game count.

rolling_snapshot.publication_rule: Only contiguous Sundays where verified_count equals game_count are stored.
rolling_snapshot.fallback_rule: Use the exact-date local rolling snapshot only when live public runtime transport is incomplete. Never mix snapshot rows into a partially live slate.

acceptance: Current Sunday has at least one game and verified_count equals game_count.
Next Sunday exists in the rolling snapshot, has at least one game, and verified_count equals game_count.
Every stored game has at least two independent sources and kickoff consensus.
Branch UI shows the Step 2 rolling-snapshot v2 marker and Open matchup is reachable.
Public UI shows the rolling-snapshot v2 deployment marker before certification proceeds.
Step 1 and Passing Yards remain frozen.
Step 2 is declared GREEN + FROZEN only after the public proof succeeds.
